item.title: The True Story of the NEPHILIM - Biblical Giants Before the Flood
item.description:
Join Sacred Feather Mysteries to uncover the terrifying truth behind biblical giants.

Twelve spies recoiled in terror. What made their blood run cold? Uncover the monstrous truth of the Nephilim and why the Great Flood was a weapon of war.

Deep in ancient scrolls lie secrets of the Nephilim: monstrous giants whose very existence provoked Noah's flood. Discover their terrifying origins, their angelic parents, and why the cataclysmic flood wasn't divine punishment but a desperate weapon of war. Uncover the untold story that reshaped humanity's fate.

⏱️ Chapters
00:00 Who were the Nephilim giants?
02:15 Who were these "sons of God"?
05:08 A shepherd's discovery in 1947
08:03 How did they return after the flood?
11:20 Why is this story in the Bible?

If you enjoy exploring the lesser-known side of the Bible, subscribe and hit the bell. New episodes every Tuesday and Sunday.

item.title: The silent music box that played again | Sleep Story
item.description:
A relaxing sleep story designed to help you unwind and fall asleep.

Tonight you'll hear "The silent music box that played again."

Let this story be a quiet refuge. In a room filled with the soft sound of rain, a dark wooden music box sits in the shadows, covered in a fine layer of dust. Its silence is ancient, holding the memory of a forgotten melody. Come closer and listen to the story held within the quiet house, a tale waiting to be heard once more.
